notes: Values are the nearest 2.5 km grid point. Only 2 m temperature is corrected for elevation (temp_2m_f); temp_2m_nbm_f is the raw grid value. Snow level is MSL and not corrected.

Temperature correction: saturated adiabatic lapse rate from the NBM cell's mean elevation to the site's elevation. It assumes saturated air, so in dry or clear weather it under-corrects, and under an inversion the true change can have the opposite sign.

Snowfall windows run 12Z to 12Z (4 am PST / 5 am PDT). The six 12 h periods (fri_day ... sun_night; day 12Z-0Z, night 0Z-12Z) are scaled sums of two 6 h windows, because the NBM has no 12 h window (see scaled_sum in scripts/nbm_snapshot.py).
p25/p50/p75 are the 25th, 50th (median) and 75th percentiles of the NBM ensemble blend.
precip_in is liquid precipitation, the sum of the NBM's deterministic 6 h APCP windows. The NBM has no APCP percentiles, so it is a single value.
snowfall method 'exceedance-interp' means the percentiles were interpolated from exceedance probabilities (more than 0.1, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 18, 24 in); treat as approximate.
